content.name: Mia Tran
content.title: Junior Graphic Designer
content.summary: Junior graphic designer with a Diploma of Graphic Design from North Metropolitan TAFE and experience across signage, print and social media. Quick with Illustrator and InDesign, careful with print specs, and designed a vehicle wrap series now running on 12 fleet vans.

experience.title: Design Work Placement
bullets: Prepared vector artwork for shopfront signage, banners and vehicle graphics on a 10-week placement.
Measured and mocked up signage on site photos so clients could approve sizes before production.
Fixed low-resolution client logos by redrawing 18 of them as clean vector files.

experience.title: Junior Graphic Designer
bullets: Design social media graphics, EDMs and print collateral for six small-business clients each month.
Created a vehicle wrap series for a plumbing client, now running on 12 fleet vans across the metro area.
Set up InDesign templates for monthly newsletters, cutting layout time from a day to about three hours.
Organise and export assets in the right sizes for each platform, avoiding rework requests from the social team.

achievements.title: TAFE graduate exhibition
achievements.detail: Selected to show a brand identity project at the 2024 end-of-year exhibition.

achievements.title: Community poster
achievements.detail: Designed the poster for a local Lunar New Year festival, printed at A1 and A3.
